rationale: The previous candidate increased base_speed to 0.75 and kd to 0.2, and switched line_loss to 'search_left' to improve line loss recovery and reduce steering oscillations, while keeping kp at 0.5 and sensor_weights at [-0.35,0.45,-0.35]. However, no telemetry was available to confirm effectiveness. To further reduce steering oscillations, I slightly increased kd to 0.22 and reduced kp to 0.45 to soften proportional response, aiming to damp oscillations more effectively. I also slightly increased the magnitude of sensor_weights to [-0.4,0.5,-0.4] to enhance sensor influence for better line tracking without risking overcorrection. The base_speed remains at 0.75 to balance speed and stability. The line_loss strategy remains 'search_left' as it was recommended for better recovery. I request telemetry on steering_oscillation and line_loss_events to verify if oscillations and line loss improve, plus completion, progress, completion_time, and rms_error to monitor overall performance. If oscillations persist, further tuning of kd or kp will be considered; if line loss remains high, alternative line_loss strategies or sensor weight adjustments will be explored.
